Titel: Interim Plant Manager (f/m/d) Greenfield Plant Poland
Unternehmen: Rheinau Polymer Group
Ort: Wrocław, Dolnośląskie, Polen
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4190055873/
Abgerufen am: 23.09.2026 07:30

About the company
Rheinau Polymer Group is a family owned manufacturer of technical plastic components for the automotive, white goods and medical technology markets, with 11 plants in Europe and around 3,800 employees. Our new plant near Wrocław starts series production in spring 2027.

The role
We are looking for an experienced Interim Plant Manager to take the new site from building handover to stable series production. You report to the COO in Germany and lead a local team that is currently being built up.

Your responsibilities
Ramp-up of injection moulding and assembly lines, including machine acceptance and process qualification
Recruitment and onboarding of the local management team (production, quality, logistics, maintenance)
Set-up of the plant organisation, shift model and Group production system
Preparation for IATF 16949 and ISO 13485 certification
Ensuring launch readiness for three customer projects, including PPAP and run at rate
Budget responsibility for the start-up phase, reporting to the COO and the Group steering committee

Your profile
Proven track record as Plant Manager or Head of Operations in a manufacturing environment
Experience with greenfield or brownfield plant ramp-ups, ideally in Central Eastern Europe
Background in injection moulding or plastics processing is a strong plus
Hands-on leadership style, able to build teams from scratch
Fluent English is mandatory, German is an advantage, Polish is a plus

What we offer
Interim assignment for 12 months with the option of extension
Start as soon as possible, at the latest January 2027
On site in Wrocław four days per week, travel to headquarters in Germany as required
Competitive daily rate, accommodation and travel costs are covered
